column6: U+2701 is no longer Extended_Pictographic in Unicode 17.0, so rule GB11 no longer joins it after a ZWJ.
Rule GB9c (Unicode 15.1) keeps consonant + virama + consonant in one cluster: 3 graphemes, not 4.
